caption:
Your inner voice is worth reading.

Save this and write down three things you tell yourself today.

From "The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech." Copy and paste the link in bio.

#thinkforyourself #montaigne #innerspeech #selfawareness #mindset

text: “I am myself the matter of my book.”
Montaigne wrote essays about one subject he could always reach.
His own mind.
He did not claim to be wise.
He simply watched himself think and wrote it down.
What he found was messy.
Moods, contradictions, changes of heart.
Most of us never look that closely.
We live inside the voice and never read it.
Try it for one day.
Write down the sentences you say to yourself.
*Just as they come.*
You cannot change what you have never noticed.
What is the most repeated sentence in your own head?
This is the thread behind the book *The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech*.
Noticing your inner voice is the first step.
Practice the pause.
*Listen in.*

caption:
Some chains are only ideas.

Send this to someone who questions everything.

From "Learn To Think For Yourself." Copy and paste the link in bio.

#thinkforyourself #rousseau #freedom #criticalthinking #mindset

text: “Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains.”
Rousseau meant laws and rulers.
But the line fits the mind too.
Some of our chains are habits of thought.
Things we believe because everyone around us does.
They feel like common sense.
That is what makes them hard to see.
You do not break a chain you cannot see.
First you have to ask where it came from.
Pick one belief today.
Ask: *Who taught me this? Did I ever choose it?*
Some beliefs will hold up. Keep those.
The rest you can set down.
Which belief of yours did you never actually choose?
This is the thread behind the book *Learn To Think For Yourself*.
Your own thinking is the whole point.
Practice the pause.
*Judge for yourself.*

caption:
The obstacle may be the lesson.

Save this, then name one obstacle and one small step.

From "The 14-Day Clarity Reset." Copy and paste the link in bio.

#thinkforyourself #marcusaurelius #stoicism #clarity #mindset

text: “The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.”
Marcus ruled an empire and fought wars.
He still wrote this note to himself.
He had learned that obstacles are not interruptions.
They are the actual work.
The blocked path teaches what the open path cannot.
Patience. Skill. Another way around.
When your day is cluttered, the clutter is the task.
Not a reason to wait for a clearer day.
Tonight, name one thing in your way.
Ask: *What is this asking me to learn?*
Then take one small step through it.
What is standing in your way right now?
This is the thread behind the book *The 14-Day Clarity Reset*.
Clarity comes from small steps taken daily.
Practice the pause.
*Start small.*

caption:
Turn the volume down on the world.

Try five quiet minutes tonight and see what comes up.

From "The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech." Copy and paste the link in bio.

#thinkforyourself #augustine #innerspeech #mindfulness #reflection

text: “Do not go outward; return within yourself. In the inner man dwells truth.”
Augustine wrote this about 1,600 years ago.
Long before screens and notifications.
Even then, he knew the pull outward.
Toward noise, opinion, and distraction.
The inner voice is where we sort what we believe.
If we ever stop to listen.
Silence is not empty.
It is where your own thoughts get to speak.
Give it five minutes tonight.
No phone. No input.
*Just hear what your mind says.*
You may be surprised by what it has been waiting to tell you.
What would your inner voice say if you gave it five quiet minutes?
This is the thread behind the book *The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech*.
Your inner voice has more to say than you think.
Practice the pause.
*Listen in.*
